universe.div: NYSE/Nasdaq, US, $300M–$15B, paid a dividend in fiscal 2024 or 2025 (SEC XBRL frames)
universe.growth: NYSE/Nasdaq, US, $300M–$50B, revenue up at least a third over three years and above $50M

divRules.name: Starting yield in the usable band
divRules.test: Yield on the current regular dividend between 1.5% and 4%

divRules.name: Dividend growing 8%+ a year
divRules.test: Regular dividend per share up at least 8% a year over five years

divRules.name: Payout with room left
divRules.test: Regular dividends 20%–60% of free cash flow over three years (earnings for utilities and financials)

divRules.name: Cash flow growing faster than the dividend
divRules.test: Five-year growth of free cash flow (earnings for utilities and financials) at least matches dividend growth

divRules.name: High return on capital
divRules.test: Return on invested capital above 12% (return on equity for insurers)

divRules.name: A moat you can say in a sentence
divRules.test: Judged by hand — only for the reviewed companies

divRules.name: Kept paying through 2020–21
divRules.test: No cut to the regular dividend in fiscal 2020 or 2021

growthRules.name: Fast revenue growth
growthRules.test: Revenue up at least 15% a year over three years

growthRules.name: Growth that keeps going
growthRules.test: Revenue up in each of the last four years, and at least 10% in the latest

growthRules.name: Margins widening with scale
growthRules.test: Operating margin positive and at least a point higher than three years ago

growthRules.name: Pays its own way
growthRules.test: Positive free cash flow in each of the last three years

growthRules.name: High return on capital
growthRules.test: Return on invested capital of 15% or more

growthRules.name: A balance sheet that can fund growth
growthRules.test: Net debt under 2× EBITDA, or net cash

growthRules.name: Owners not diluted
growthRules.test: Diluted share count growing under 3% a year over three years

growthRules.name: A price growth can justify
growthRules.test: P/E divided by three-year EPS growth (PEG) under 2

growthRules.name: Rule of 40
growthRules.test: Latest revenue growth plus free-cash-flow margin of 40 or more
